en.text:
Kills or collecting a <void/>Void Breach grants 'Nightsworn Sight' for 7 seconds and Truesight for 3 seconds.

Allies with Slayer's Fang within ? meters of you also receive the Nightsworn Sight when you score a kill with the gun.

Nightsworn Sight grants ? Reload speed and the following benefits:
• 15% increased Precision Damage
• 10% increased damage against Fallen and Scorn
• Automatically load 2 rounds from reserves every 4 seconds
• Submunitions apply <void/>Weaken for 4 seconds
• Submunitions deal 18% decreased damage and bounce 1 additional time.

Buff can be activated while stowed.
